# MSD Veterinary Manual

> The MSD Veterinary Manual is a comprehensive, evidence-based resource for veterinary professionals and pet owners covering diagnosis, treatment, disease prevention, and emergency care across all animal species.

Developed and maintained by MSD in collaboration with veterinary experts and academic institutions, the manual serves as a trusted clinical reference for veterinarians and an accessible health guide for pet owners. Content spans toxicology, musculoskeletal disorders, emergency medicine, and specialized care for birds and exotic pets.

## Key Topics

- Veterinary Medicine
- Clinical Reference
- Pet Health
- Emergency Care
- Toxicology and Poisoning
- Livestock Disease
- Bird Health
- Body Systems
- Veterinary Topics
- Pet Safety
- Hypernatremia
- Musculoskeletal Disorders
- Diagnostic Procedures
- Treatment Protocols
- Disease Prevention

## Core Resources

- [MSD Veterinary Manual](https://www.msdvetmanual.com): Homepage for trusted veterinary resource covering diagnosis, treatment, and disease prevention.
- [Veterinary Topics](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/veterinary-topics): Directory and index of veterinary topics organized by specialty and body systems.
- [Pet Owners Overview](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/resourcespages/pet-owners-overview): Resource hub for pet owners covering home care, emergency care, and pet types.
- [About the MSD Veterinary Manual](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/resourcespages/about): About page describing the MSD Veterinary Manual, its mission, and editorial team.

## Emergency Care & Pet Safety

- [What to Do in a Dog or Cat Emergency](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/special-pet-topics/emergencies/what-to-do-in-a-dog-or-cat-emergency): First-aid guide for dog and cat emergencies including CPR and emergency response.
- [Household Hazards for Pet Birds](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/bird-owners/routine-care-and-safety-of-birds/household-hazards-for-pet-birds): Guide to household hazards and injury prevention for pet bird owners.
- [Planning for Travel With Pets](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/special-pet-topics/travel-with-pets/planning-for-travel-with-pets): Guide to pet travel planning covering vaccinations, identification, and safety.

## Clinical Reference & Disease Management

- [Salt Toxicosis in Animals](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/toxicology/salt-toxicosis/salt-toxicosis-in-animals): Clinical reference on salt toxicosis, hypernatremia, and treatment in livestock.
- [Contagious Footrot in Sheep](https://www.msdvetmanual.com/musculoskeletal-system/lameness-in-sheep/contagious-footrot-in-sheep): Clinical reference on contagious footrot in sheep with diagnosis and treatment.
